operations.why: Baseline-audited against EntityEventPacketEventId. The Prismarine enum omits names for several occupied slots (including slot 0), while Mojang names those slots; the shared values retain their ordinal positions, so this mapping intentionally stays sequential. See crates/valentine/bedrock_versions/v1_26_30/src/proto.rs and https://github.com/Mojang/bedrock-protocol-docs/blob/ba81d713aa983bb6bc26fe662a9934c5de1838a5/json/ActorEventPacket.json.

See https://github.com/Mojang/bedrock-protocol-docs/tree/ba81d713aa983bb6bc26fe662a9934c5de1838a5/json.
